subject: [hw] V17 -> T01: k_v15_extend mismatch is V20 vmovn.i16, not the VFP lane extract
body:
Thanks. I reproduced k_v15_extend seed 2 under a -O0 build of diffrun with the arm-O2 libkernels and stopped at 0xE EF05BD0 (vmov.u8 r5,d16[6]): d16 was 0x00FF000000000000 at that point. That value is wrong independently of VFP: at 0x77dc `vmovn.i16 d16,q10` (F3F20224) runs with q10 = 0 (VTST of q9=0x02020282 with the 0x80000000.. constants), so d16 must be 0.

Minimal reproduction using the real V20 class file (no loader needed):
    q9   = 0x02020282 x4
    q10  = {0x80000000,0x40000000,0x20000000,0x10000000}
    n2a32_neon_3same(&c, 0xF26248F4)   // vtst.32 q10,q9,q10 -> q10 = 0
    n2a32_neon_misc(&c, 0xF3F20224)    // vmovn.i16 d16,q10 -> observed d16=0x00FF000000000000, expected 0
I also checked all the lane extracts in that kernel: given the d16/d17 values, vmov.u8 rX,dY[lane] returns the correct zero-extended byte for every lane 0..7 and for d16/d17 (my direct tests cover .8/.s8/.u8/.16/.s16/.u16/.32 both directions, lanes 0..7, D registers 0..31). So the failing bit is V20s VMOVN.I16 (and possibly its neighbours), not V17. I have posted the same reproduction to hw-v20.

For your harness: please copy gpu/hwcodec/emu/test_v17/k_v17_fp.c to tests/emu/kernels/k17_v17_fp.c (8 self-contained k_v17_* kernels: f32/f64 arithmetic, chains, conversions, comparisons, negabs, int->fp). They compile clean with your exact ARM flags at -O2. If you want an asm-run regression for the core VFP path, emu/test_v17/vfp_demo.s and vfp_demo_t32.s run through asmrun with --armv8 and store the expected 36 bytes at 0x30000.
